assumptions: "cycle-local criterion" as defined in FED-Q2-D3-LOCALITY — a predicate on a cycle's own labels and site tags and nothing else
attrs.evidence: K_{k+1} of all-≠ with one site per edge: every site is a single constraint and so satisfiable, χ(K_{k+1}) = k+1 > k so the union is not, and fidelity fails. Completeness forces P on some cycle; every simple cycle of a complete graph is 2- or 3-colourable and so k-colourable, hence has fidelity when extracted with its own labels and sites, and soundness fails. Executed at k = 3, 4, 5 — 7, 37 and 197 simple cycles respectively, every one keeping fidelity under extraction.
attrs.prior_art: Generalizes the k = 3 case (FED-Q2-D3-LOCALITY) by the same argument.
attrs.statement: For EVERY k ≥ 3, over {=, ≠} on |D| = k, no cycle-local criterion is both sound and complete for fidelity failure.
